title: 9 Signs a Godly Man's Work Ethic Is Actually Worship
caption:
9 signs a godly man's work ethic is actually worship.

Not a personality trait.

He shows up on the days he doesn't feel like it. He does the boring five percent nobody sees. He tells the truth about the numbers, even the bad ones. He works like Someone's actually watching, because Someone is.

Whatever you do, work at it as for the Lord and not for men (Colossians 3:23).

He's the same worker broke and the same worker promoted. Neither one changes what he's actually working for.
